value.rationale: This completely resolves the shortest simple free-homotopy layer in a canonical small triangulation of a nonabelian spherical 3-manifold. A nullhomologous order-four type occurs at the same minimum length as the homologically visible order-six type, concretely showing that H_1 misses an entire shortest noncontractible family. This relationship among simplicial length, nonabelian pi_1, and abelianization is structural rather than an arbitrary finite statistic.
